summary: Sample data, not a model result. For the week ending 2026-08-09, the sample model estimates U.S. corn yield at 182.8 bu/acre (range 175.7 to 188.5) and soybeans at 51.1 bu/acre (range 48.8 to 53.0).
bullets: Corn: the sample estimate is 0.7 bu/acre above the July 2026 WASDE figure of 182.1 bu/acre.
Soybeans: the sample estimate is 1.8 bu/acre below the July 2026 WASDE figure of 52.9 bu/acre.
